description: Decode a QR code in a PNG or JPEG result image. Accepts compatible 12 Axes result links from any domain, including 12axes.vercel.app. Returns the decoded URL and a 12axes.cc result URL for axes_explain_result or axes_compare_results. Does not read printed text, infer scores, fetch the decoded link, or support images without a compatible QR. The image is processed for this request.

image_base64.description: Base64 of the actual PNG or JPEG file bytes, optionally a data URL. Never pass a file path, web URL, description or placeholder. Up to 4 MiB, 4 megapixels and 4096 pixels per side. If image bytes are inaccessible, ask for the result link.

name: axes_read_result_qr
title: Read a result QR from an image
